name: studywise
description: STUDYWISE. En KI-basert studieassistent for høyere utdanning med integrasjon mot Canvas Instructure. Bachelor i IT 2026.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "pnpm dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:4000/health -t 60000 && pnpm dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:4000/health -t 60000 && pnpm dev:docs"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter docs build
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.clean:install: node scripts/clean.mjs && pnpm install && pnpm -r update && pnpm build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter common test && pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.test:auth: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx run.ts auth
scripts.test:auth:e2e: pnpm --filter tests exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:auth:matrix: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts full
scripts.test:auth:matrix:basic: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts basic
scripts.test:auth:matrix:oauth: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts oauth
scripts.test:auth:matrix:update: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts update
scripts.test:auth:matrix:delete: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts delete
scripts.test:auth:matrix:session: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts session
scripts.test:auth:matrix:race: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx auth/expanded-matrix.ts race
scripts.test:ki: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx run.ts ki
scripts.test:canvas: pnpm --filter tests exec tsx run.ts canvas
